fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of the "touch" process in service file.
fields.name: Touch Suspicious Service File
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/touch" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -t " and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".service"))
